name: STC-05GE.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Ethernet Switch/STC-05GE.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts high-quality and high-speed network intelligent chip and completely solves the noise problem of small switches in the office environment through the fan-less mute design
This switch has 5 Gigabit RJ45 ports enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M Ethernet
easy to manage and maintain
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
5*10/ 100/ 1000M RJ45 Ports
Apply to IEEE802.3, IEEE802.3u, IEEE802.3ab standard
Ethernet port supports 10/100/1000M adaptive
Support auto MDI/ MDIX
Panel indicators to monitor working status and help fault analysis
Flow control, full duplex adopts IEEE802.3x standard, half duplex adopts Back pressure standard
Specification
Product Name	5 Port 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet Switch
Port	5x10/100/1000M UTP RJ45(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing)
Switching Capacity	10Gbps
Throughput	7.44Mpps
Packet Buffer	3M
MAC Address	2K
Jumbo Frame	15Kbytes
VLAN	4K
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3(10Base-T) / IEEE802.3u(100Base-TX) / IEEE802.3ab(1000Base-TX) / IEEE802.3x(Flow control)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR(EN55032) class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2(ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	DC5V1A
Power Consumption	＜5W
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / Link(Network Link) / On: 10/100/1000M link connection is normal / Blinking: Data transmission is normal / Off: link failure
Application
IP-based Communication
Vehicle Network Solution
Dimension
Remark

Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power adapter(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 87*54*23mm
Inner box size: 90*88*58mm
Product weight: 0.13Kg
Packing weight: 0.2Kg
Master box size: 470*320*380mm
Packing quantity: 100Pcs
Packing weight: 21Kg
Remark
Accessories(Network cable etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Power adapter is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
